Definition
[Subdifferential] ↗ def:convex-function-hilbert-space 1. ch9:9.6.1-def-3\group Convex Analysis

Let $I : H \to (-\infty , +\infty ]$ be convex and proper.

  1. For each $u \in H$, we write

    \[ \partial I[u] := \{ v \in H \mid I[w] \ge I[u] + (v, w-u) \text{ for all } w \in H\} . \tag {1} \]

    The mapping $\partial I : H \to 2^H$ is the subdifferential of $I$.

  2. We say $u \in D(\partial I)$, the domain of $\partial I$, provided $\partial I[u] \ne \emptyset $.
